interview:
The following information provides important details about what the company expects from you during the investigation. Although the discussion may be a bit uncomfortable, the company expects and appreciates your full participation in this process. We expect you to cooperate by answering all questions completely and honestly, providing and not deleting any documents that are relevant to the investigation, and making yourself available for follow-up interviews if necessary. You will be excused from your usual work duties for interviews and any other activities necessary to the investigation. If you are a member of a union and would like to have representation at your interview, you may exercise your Weingarten Rights by contacting INVESTIGATOR prior to your scheduled interview. 
Retaliation against anyone involved in the investigation is prohibited by company policy and is unlawful. If you retaliate against anyone involved in this investigation, you will be subject to discipline. If you believe you have been mistreated or otherwise retaliated against because of your participation in this investigation, please notify INVESTIGATOR or a Senior Manager immediately.
We will maintain the confidentiality of the investigation to the extent possible, revealing information only on a need-to-know basis to those involved in the investigation. In order to protect the integrity of the investigation process, it is our hope that the accusations made and the questions asked in the interviews will not be discussed with others in the workplace until after the investigation has been concluded. And after such conclusion, it is best to refrain from discussing the incident as a simple matter of respect and to protect the privacy of all parties involved.
After the interview, if you remember additional information or if you would like to change or add to your statement for any other reason, please contact INVESTIGATOR.
final:
We take claims of this nature very seriously. It is our policy and practice to undertake a prompt and impartial investigation in accordance with the law, take action that is appropriate based on the findings of the investigation, and take appropriate steps to ensure behavior of this nature does not continue within our organization.
Although we cannot share the details of the corrective disciplinary actions, if any, taken against other parties in the investigation, be assured that we are acting swiftly and appropriately to resolve this matter in a way which allows all parties to move forward. A member of management will be meeting with you personally if any further action is needed.
Should you have any concerns or experience any future misconduct, including any retaliation, please do not hesitate to inform your manager or other trusted member of the management team.
